common.droneTabHint: Drone safety status and lock events come from the real backend; trigger / resolve locks and register missions in Operations & Safety Control.
common.opsSubtitle: The single entry point for drone mission registration and flight safety control: trigger / resolve locks and record missions here.

airspace.title: Airspace Management
airspace.subtitle: Platform-level airspace zones (geo-fence): the level decides whether a flight plan can be approved. Only OPERATIONAL zones accept flight plans.
airspace.immutableTip: Once created, an airspace zone cannot be modified or disabled. Please fill in carefully and double-check the name, level, center coordinates and radius before submitting.
airspace.immutableConfirmDesc: Once created, an airspace zone cannot be modified or disabled. Please confirm the parameters below:
airspace.createdDesc: To adjust it, create a new zone with a new name (e.g. append -R2 to the original name).

map.title: Airspace overview
map.empty: No airspace zone yet. The overview appears here after you create one.

flightPlan.title: Flight Plans
flightPlan.subtitle: A flight plan must fall inside an OPERATIONAL zone and the pilot license must be valid. Submitting passes the compliance check.
flightPlan.complianceTip: The zone dropdown lists OPERATIONAL zones only; restricted / no-fly zones never appear, and expired licenses cannot be selected. The backend re-checks the zone level and existence on submit.
flightPlan.flowTip: In the current version a submitted plan goes straight to APPROVED. Take-off / completion / violation transitions are pending backend support.

msg.created: Flight plan submitted and passed the compliance check. Status: APPROVED
msg.notOperationalRule: This zone is not an operational zone. Please select an operational one.

err.notOperational: This airspace zone is not an operational zone. The flight plan cannot be approved.
err.zoneNotFound: The selected airspace zone does not exist. Please refresh and retry.
err.assetLocked: This asset is currently locked. Resolve the lock before scheduling a flight plan.

confirm.title: Confirm submitting this flight plan?
confirm.desc: Once submitted a flight plan cannot be modified and its status goes straight to APPROVED. Please confirm the parameters below:

license.title: Pilot Licenses
license.subtitle: Pilot licenses (issued by SSCA by default): flight plans and mission records both validate the license. License numbers are unique.
license.renewTip: When a license expires, ask the platform to register a new one. Renewal is not supported in this version — create a new record with a new license number (e.g. append -R2 to the original number).

summary.warning: {{total}} licenses · {{expiring}} expire within {{days}} days and {{expired}} already expired. Please arrange renewal in time.

err.duplicate: This license number already exists. Please check and retry.

msg.assetLockedWarning: This asset is currently locked. Please confirm whether this mission was completed before the lock.

fence.title: Device Geofence
fence.subtitle: Set a geofence (circular / polygon) per drone device. Breach can trigger an alert or a lock.
fence.autoLockNote: Auto-lock is not yet connected: saving a geofence does not trigger auto-lock (breach auto-lock is judged by the platform side and the backend is not yet connected).
fence.platformNote: Platform-level airspace zones (no-fly / restricted) are managed in Airspace Management.

err.invalid: Invalid geofence parameters. Please check coordinates or WKT format (>=3 points, balanced brackets)

fence.confirmDelete: Confirm deleting this geofence? This cannot be undone.

normal.title: Cleared for take-off
normal.desc: Flight safety is normal: airspace compliant, link online, battery sufficient. Take-off allowed.

locked.title: Locked
locked.desc: Locked: triggered by geofence violation / lost link / low battery or manual action. Take-off prohibited (similar to lock-on payment default). Must be resolved before flying.

msg.nothingToResolve: There is no unresolved lock event

confirm.multiDesc: There are {{count}} unresolved events. This action resolves 1 of them (the earliest one). Repeat until all are resolved.

safety.empty: No safety event for this asset
safety.autoLockNote: Auto-lock is not yet connected: saving a geofence does not trigger auto-lock.
